correctness.rationale: Exact Bartlett independence and beta-gamma law prove finite integral for every integer s>=2; the strict constrained Wishart saddle yields I>0 uniquely for 1<T<K. Exact exponential likelihood tilt and smooth Wishart density near the nondegenerate boundary saddle yield the derived sqrt(s) prefactor, with algebra independently checked numerically. The fixed-basis independence and parameter boundaries are explicit; stochastic tests support but do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The condition-number acceptance test controls randomized restarting with nonorthogonal Krylov bases. This result calibrates a natural failure event beyond generic sketch distortion inequalities, with a full finite-s beta formula, sharp exponential rarity and actual leading multiplier; the explicit 2-column case is the minimal nontrivial numerical benchmark and informs choice of sketch dimension without asserting entire adaptive-run reliability.
